acceptanceCriteria: A merge batch of >200 paths and ~900 hunks binds, checks and seals through a supported documented path, or the contract states an explicit supported alternative with its retained uncertainty.
Each refusal (git-budget-exceeded, admitted-path-limit, intent-scope-drift) names its recovery.
body:
Source: w4 batch lane, PR beamfall/corvint#789.

## Observed
Binding the batch merge (877 hunks, >200 paths) with dogfood fails: cem-status reports git-budget-exceeded (1,024 Git-operation budget), ocm-prepare is NOT_PRODUCED, intent-scope-drift is raised, and local-outcome refuses with admitted-path-limit (>200 paths), so dogfood-check ends in dogfood-report-drift.

## Expected
A supported batch/merge-commit evidence path so integration batches can be bound and sealed (related: V1-0611 admitted-path limit, V1-1107 citation plan cap, V1-0145 report-drift conflation).

## Actual
Batch merges cannot be sealed.

completion.reason: Delivered in beamfall/corvint#799 (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/799; landed by batch PR #799); on main at 10efc02d16e6069d73426e6d6abd860e71ae83ab (https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/pull/799). Tests named in the PR: DCW-V0-039/040 dogfood batch-check tests. Doc gates, repin check, independent review and dogfood bind/check/seal reported PASS in the PR. make gate NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference); native claim unavailable (COVERAGE_UNKNOWN/RESOURCE_COLLISION). Evidence: sha256 of the build-log/decision record(s) at the merge commit.

title: dogfood cannot bind a large merge batch: git-budget-exceeded, ocm-prepare NOT_PRODUCED, admitted-path-limit (w4 batch PR beamfall/corvint#789)
